source.author: verg
source.text: Praeterea iam nec mutari pabula refert artes nocent quaesitaeque; cessere magistri Phillyrides Chiron Amythaoniusque Melampus.
source.text_original: Praeterea iam nec mutari pabula refert / artes nocent quaesitaeque; cessere magistri / Phillyrides Chiron Amythaoniusque Melampus.
source.text_english: Moreover, now it makes no difference to change pastures; the arts are harmful and have been acquired for harm; even the masters have given way: Chiron, son of Philyra, and Melampus, son of Amythaon.
